requirements.title: Initial Video-Ad Deliverable
requirements.definition: Produce the commissioned video-ad quantity and duration, ultimately an initial 30-second test ad before any additional creatives are ordered.
requirements.boundary_note: Quantity, duration, and staged commissioning form the final-ad deliverable mechanism; aspect-ratio exports and the temporary preview workflow remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: 9:16 and 4:5 Video Exports
requirements.definition: Deliver the completed ad in both 9:16 and 4:5 aspect ratios.
requirements.boundary_note: Export-format compliance can be delivered or corrected independently of the ad's narrative, duration, and production quality.

requirements.title: Hindi Preview Before Full Production
requirements.definition: Provide a short Hindi visual-and-dialogue preview for client review before completing the full video.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a separately requested intermediate review artifact, not generic testing activity and not the final 30-second deliverable.

requirements.title: Video Delivery Deadline
requirements.definition: Deliver the commissioned video within the agreed or subsequently imposed task deadline.
requirements.boundary_note: The delivery-time obligation evolves independently from the video's creative and technical acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Conversion-Focused Creative
requirements.definition: Design the ad primarily to generate conversions and pursue a cost-per-lead goal below ₹50 rather than merely improving aesthetics.
requirements.boundary_note: This captures the client-directed business objective, not a guaranteed campaign result; specific hook, script, editing, and audio criteria remain independent Requirements.

requirements.title: Creative Concept and Reference Strategy
requirements.definition: Use the client-approved narrative concept, initially a fresh testimonial-style treatment and later a better product-specific version modeled on the last reference video.
requirements.boundary_note: This owns the high-level narrative and reference relationship; exact keywords, opening-hook behavior, actors, and visual realism can evolve independently.

requirements.title: Direct High-Attention Opening Hook
requirements.definition: Open with a strong, direct, non-generic hook designed to capture Indian-market attention within the first seconds.
requirements.boundary_note: Hook directness and attention capture have their own failure and revision trajectory, distinct from the remainder of the script and visual editing.

requirements.title: Product Keywords and Claims
requirements.definition: Build the script around the product benefits and high-performing pain-point language from the winning and reference ads, avoid generic wording, and omit prohibited terminology.
requirements.boundary_note: Specific keyword and claim selection is one messaging mechanism; language localization, audience targeting, hook structure, and visual product inclusion remain separate.

requirements.title: Hindi-Language Script
requirements.definition: Prepare and present the complete ad script in Hindi rather than English.
requirements.boundary_note: Written-script localization can be reviewed and changed independently of voice recording and therefore remains separate from Hindi voiceover.

requirements.title: Hindi Voiceover Production
requirements.definition: Supply a natural Hindi voiceover for the video rather than requiring the client to provide voice talent.
requirements.boundary_note: Voiceover production and spoken-language execution are independently assessable from the written script and final audio mix.

requirements.title: Realistic AI-Generated UGC Scenes
requirements.definition: Create native-looking AI-generated UGC video scenes that use real motion rather than avatars or static-image animation and do not appear obviously artificial.
requirements.boundary_note: This owns the scene-generation method and overall realism; actor nationality, product handling, lip sync, and pack-shot quality are independently testable behaviors.

requirements.title: Inclusion of Both Products
requirements.definition: Feature both the original Vedicurja product and the second diabetes-related product in the completed video.
requirements.boundary_note: Mandatory visual inclusion of both products is separate from whether the optional diabetes benefit is emphasized in dialogue and from how the second pack shot is generated.

requirements.title: Strategic Cuts and Fast Pacing
requirements.definition: Use appropriately timed, fast-paced cuts and smooth transitions designed to sustain attention and retention.
requirements.boundary_note: Visual pacing can be modified and assessed independently of the opening-hook wording, audio mix, subtitles, and generated-scene realism.

requirements.title: Professional Audio Mixing
requirements.definition: Mix dialogue, music, and sound effects at appropriate, professionally balanced social-media audio levels.
requirements.boundary_note: Audio-level compliance is independently testable from voiceover language, scene editing, and visual quality; the exact meaning of the client's 'Audio DB 25' remains uncertain.

requirements.title: UGC Color Grading and Final Polish
requirements.definition: Color-grade and polish the final ad so it retains a professional but native Facebook and Instagram UGC appearance.
requirements.boundary_note: Final visual finishing is independently assessable from generated-scene realism, actor casting, product pack shots, and editing pace.

source_message.text:
Absolutely. Before we proceed, I want to clarify one point so we're aligned.

You mentioned using actual footage instead of avatars or static-image animation. I agree with avoiding avatars and static-image animation, but my recommendation is not to use traditional live-action footage either.

Instead, I'll create AI-generated video scenes that are designed to look like authentic handheld UGC. I recommend this approach because it gives us greater creative flexibility while still producing realistic human movement, natural product interaction, proper lip sync, and a consistent visual style. The objective is to create videos that feel native to Instagram rather than looking obviously AI-generated.

Production Workflow

- Generate realistic AI video scenes (no AI avatars or static-image animation).

- Create natural handheld-style shots with realistic product handling and environments.

- Apply accurate lip sync and natural facial expressions where dialogue is included.

- Edit with a strong hook, fast-paced cuts, captions, sound design, and CTA optimized for short-form performance.

- Color grade and refine the final output to achieve a polished, organic UGC look.

To produce the best result, I'll need:

- High-resolution product images from multiple angles.

- Packaging images (front, back, and inside if applicable).

- Your logo and any brand guidelines (if available).

- Your product or landing page.
